name: Pale Huntsman
description: A spectral gamekeeper who still follows trespassers through the lower halls. His spear is solid bone, even when his cloak seems weightless.

abilities.description: Up to 4 damage per strike bypasses block after slow, plating and resistance reduce the strike.
Starts with 4 opening block. Any remainder expires after round two.
